PreToolUse.command: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"), path = require("path"), cp = require("child_process"); const names = ["pre-tool-safety", "deny-non-read-git"]; const p = names.map(name => [path.join(process.env.HOME||"", ".copilot/hooks/"+name+".json"), path.join(process.env.HOME||"", ".agents/hooks/"+name+".json"), "./agent-hooks/"+name+".json", "./.github/hooks/"+name+".json", "./.agents/hooks/"+name+".json"]).flat().find(f => fs.existsSync(f)); if (!p) process.exit(0); const dir = path.dirname(fs.realpathSync(p)); const js = path.join(dir, "pre-tool-safety.js"); if (fs.existsSync(js)) { cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, [js], { stdio: "inherit" }); } else { const mts = path.join(dir, "pre-tool-safety.mts"); if (fs.existsSync(mts)) cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--import", "tsx", mts], { stdio: "inherit" }); }'
